title: ERP · Unified clinical workspace
brief: Connected Spanish dental ERP prototype for one fictional clinic, with one sourced shell and in-memory reset. S1-S42: full patient/resource/reference/medicine CRUD, typed master columns and immutable links; human-selected clinical diagnoses/Rx, manual notes/recommendations, explicit draft save/completion and read-only snapshots. Only selected Aranceles services create integer-cent orders settled by cash/non-payable QR/receipts; free Lab/Imagen studies and outgoing Pagos remain separate. Paid orders omit QR/payment filler. Role-targeted Navigation/menu/Resumen grants are name-independent and intersect personal visibility. S41/S42: Laboratorio/Imagenología now default to Solicitudes y resultados queues; separate Catálogo retains Nombre/Descripción-only CRUD. Human requests receive one atomic immutable batch of 1–5 PDF/JPG/JPEG/PNG files up to10MiB each, metadata allowlisting, literal names, scoped local downloads and no inline execution, OCR or typed findings. Late fulfillment preserves closed clinical/business state. Files are opaque session-only references; reload/logout discards them and old URLs are unusable. No backend storage or content-security certification. Accessible text login and modal/clinical controls, unique navigation icons and spacing remain. Latest author HTTP2653 plus independent scoped34 checks and actual63977 document flow passed without forbidden API/storage/external operations/page errors. No native authority approval or production readiness.

artboards.title: Unified business workspace
artboards.tradeoff: A connected prototype, not production software. Dedicated study-result queues make document attachment discoverable without turning descriptive Lab/Imagen catalogs into billable services. Only PDF/JPG/PNG document batches and downloads: no text findings, parsing, OCR, inline preview, replacement/deletion or persistent storage. Validated atomic updates preserve patient/mode/role scope, closed clinical snapshots and finances; cancel/reselect and reset loss are tested. The previous visible-text login fix, role/content configuration, CRUD and financial workflows remain. Author2653 and independent34 checks plus actual63977 attachment/download acceptance passed. Real file-security validation, backend storage and production authentication remain future work.
